subtopics.label: Opioid Stewardship, Prescribing Policy & Regulation
subtopics.description: Research examining the effects of state and federal opioid prescribing laws, prescription drug monitoring programs, prescribing cap legislation, and institutional policies on opioid dispensing patterns, persistent opioid use, and overdose outcomes across surgical and chronic pain populations.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of state and federal opioid laws, monitoring programs, and prescribing caps on dispensing patterns and overdose outcomes.

subtopics.label: Postoperative Opioid Prescribing & Perioperative Analgesia
subtopics.description: Studies investigating postoperative opioid prescribing patterns, multimodal analgesia strategies, opioid-sparing techniques, and persistent postoperative opioid use across diverse surgical procedures and patient populations.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid-sparing strategies, multimodal analgesia, and persistent postoperative opioid use across surgical populations.

subtopics.label: Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy & Corneal Confocal Microscopy
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, progression, and risk factors of diabetic peripheral neuropathy using corneal confocal microscopy and quantitative sensory testing, including the impact of glycemic control, metabolic factors, and pharmacological interventions on nerve fiber loss.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and progression of diabetic peripheral neuropathy using corneal confocal microscopy and quantitative sensory testing.

subtopics.label: Headache Disorders & Surgical Nerve Decompression
subtopics.description: Research on the surgical management of headache disorders including occipital neuralgia, nerve compression headaches, and migraine via nerve decompression, trigger-site deactivation, and neuromodulation, including outcomes, treatment delays, and anatomical considerations.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of occipital neuralgia, migraine, and nerve compression headaches via decompression and neuromodulation.

subtopics.label: Migraine Treatment & Pharmacotherapy
subtopics.description: Studies on pharmacological prevention and acute treatment of migraine, including CGRP-targeted monoclonal antibodies, onabotulinumtoxinA, and combination therapies, as well as socioeconomic and psychiatric factors influencing migraine medication use and adherence.
subtopics.short_description: CGRP-targeted therapies, onabotulinumtoxinA, and socioeconomic factors influencing migraine medication use and adherence.

subtopics.label: Anesthetic Mechanisms & Pharmacology
subtopics.description: Basic and translational research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms of volatile and intravenous anesthetics, including ion channel modulation (K2P, HCN, Nav, TRPV channels), effects on synaptic transmission, presynaptic calcium dynamics, and neuronal excitability.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular and cellular mechanisms of volatile and intravenous anesthetics, including ion channel modulation and synaptic effects.

subtopics.label: Regional Anesthesia & Neuraxial Techniques
subtopics.description: Clinical research on regional anesthesia techniques including neuraxial blocks, peripheral nerve blocks, epidural injections, and local anesthetic pharmacology, covering efficacy, complications, and applications in obstetric, surgical, and interventional pain settings.
subtopics.short_description: Neuraxial blocks, peripheral nerve blocks, and epidural injections across obstetric, surgical, and interventional pain settings.

subtopics.label: Chronic Pain Psychology, Psychosocial Factors & Self-Management
subtopics.description: Research on psychological, social, and behavioral dimensions of chronic pain including cognitive-behavioral interventions, positive affect skills, discrimination, stress, well-being practices, and digital or peer-support tools for chronic pain self-management.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive-behavioral interventions, psychosocial factors, and digital tools for chronic pain self-management and well-being.

subtopics.label: Cancer Pain Management & Opioid Use in Oncology
subtopics.description: Studies on opioid prescribing, access, and outcomes for cancer patients including bone metastasis, pancreatic cancer, and advanced illness, as well as the impact of cannabis legalization, Medicare coverage restrictions, and celiac plexus neurolysis on cancer pain management.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid access, prescribing, and outcomes for cancer patients, including celiac plexus neurolysis and cannabis policy impacts.

subtopics.label: Chronic Pelvic Pain & Urologic Pain Syndromes
subtopics.description: Research on urologic chronic pelvic pain syndrome (UCPPS), interstitial cystitis, and related conditions, including pelvic floor muscle tenderness, sexual dysfunction, bladder hyperalgesia, and multidisciplinary approaches to diagnosis and treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Urologic chronic pelvic pain, interstitial cystitis, bladder hyperalgesia, and multidisciplinary diagnosis and treatment approaches.

subtopics.label: Neuromodulation & Interventional Pain Procedures
subtopics.description: Clinical research on interventional pain management techniques including spinal cord stimulation, radiofrequency neurotomy, transcranial direct current stimulation, occipital nerve stimulation, and virtual reality-assisted procedural training and pain relief.
subtopics.short_description: Spinal cord stimulation, radiofrequency neurotomy, transcranial stimulation, and virtual reality-assisted procedural pain relief.

subtopics.label: Perioperative Care, Enhanced Recovery & Critical Care Analgesia
subtopics.description: Research on enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocols, perioperative fluid management, sedation practices in the ICU, ketamine use in mechanically ventilated patients, and multidisciplinary approaches to reducing postoperative complications and length of stay.
subtopics.short_description: ERAS protocols, ICU sedation, perioperative fluid management, and ketamine use to reduce complications and length of stay.

subtopics.label: Neuropathic Pain Biology & Peripheral Nerve Pathology
subtopics.description: Translational and clinical research on neuropathic pain mechanisms including small fiber neuropathy, peripheral nerve injury, traumatic neuromas, corneal nerve loss in non-diabetic conditions (COVID-19, Guillain-Barré), and pharmacological targets such as HCN channels and probucol.
subtopics.short_description: Small fiber neuropathy, peripheral nerve injury, traumatic neuromas, and pharmacological targets including HCN channels.

subtopics.label: Opioid Pharmacology, Addiction Biology & Cannabis Interactions
subtopics.description: Basic science and translational research on opioid receptor biology, hippocampal opioid system modulation by sex and stress, endocannabinoid interactions with opioid reward and analgesia, and the relationship between cannabis laws and opioid use disorder outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid receptor biology, endocannabinoid-opioid interactions, and cannabis law effects on opioid use disorder outcomes.

subtopics.label: Pain Care Disparities, Access & Health Equity
subtopics.description: Research examining racial, ethnic, socioeconomic, and geographic disparities in pain treatment, opioid access, anesthesia techniques, and adherence to pain management protocols across surgical, obstetric, and chronic pain populations.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, socioeconomic, and geographic disparities in pain treatment, opioid access, and anesthesia across populations.

subtopics.label: Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery & Decompression Techniques
subtopics.description: Research on minimally invasive surgical approaches for spinal conditions including tubular laminotomy, endoscopic techniques, TLIF, LLIF, and cervical decompression procedures, evaluating clinical outcomes, safety, and technical innovations.
subtopics.short_description: Tubular laminotomy, endoscopic techniques, and TLIF/LLIF approaches for spinal conditions, evaluating outcomes and safety.

subtopics.label: Cervical Spine Surgery: Outcomes & Complications
subtopics.description: Studies examining clinical and radiographic outcomes of cervical spine procedures including ACDF, laminoplasty, corpectomy, atlantoaxial fusion, and foraminotomy, with attention to complications, fusion rates, and patient selection.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and radiographic outcomes of ACDF, laminoplasty, corpectomy, and atlantoaxial fusion, including complication rates.

subtopics.label: Breast Sensation Recovery After Mastectomy & Reconstruction
subtopics.description: Research on sensory outcomes following mastectomy and breast reconstruction, including neurotized DIEP flaps, implant-based reconstruction, nipple-areola complex reinnervation, and factors affecting sensory recovery and quality of life.
subtopics.short_description: Sensory outcomes following mastectomy and reconstruction, including neurotized DIEP flaps and nipple-areola reinnervation.

subtopics.label: Lung Transplantation: Perioperative Management & Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies on intraoperative and perioperative management of lung transplant patients, including extubation timing, blood lactate as a predictor of graft dysfunction, disease-specific implications, and multidisciplinary care strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Intraoperative and perioperative care of lung transplant patients, including extubation timing and graft dysfunction predictors.

subtopics.label: Intervertebral Disc Degeneration & Regenerative Therapies
subtopics.description: Research on the pathophysiology of intervertebral disc degeneration and evaluation of regenerative and non-stem-cell-based therapeutic approaches including biological injections and structural interventions for chronic low back pain.
subtopics.short_description: Pathophysiology of intervertebral disc degeneration and biological or structural interventions for chronic low back pain.

subtopics.label: Complementary & Integrative Medicine in Palliative & Supportive Care
subtopics.description: Studies examining the use, perception, and evidence base for complementary and integrative medicine (CIM) approaches—including acupuncture, aromatherapy, tai chi, and spiritual care—for pain and symptom management in palliative, oncologic, and chronic pain populations.
subtopics.short_description: Acupuncture, aromatherapy, tai chi, and spiritual care for pain and symptom management in palliative and oncologic settings.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Pain Management, Opioid Use & Sedation
subtopics.description: Research on opioid prescribing, sedation practices, and analgesia in pediatric populations, including PICU sedation, opioid cap laws affecting youth, maternal opioid prescriptions and child outcomes, and minimally invasive anesthesia for pediatric procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid prescribing, PICU sedation, and analgesia in children, including opioid cap laws and maternal prescription impacts.

subtopics.label: Pain Assessment & Management in Older Adults & Home Care
subtopics.description: Studies on pain measurement tools, drug use patterns, and pain experiences in older adults receiving home care or managing chronic conditions, including multidimensional assessment instruments and heart failure-related pain.
subtopics.short_description: Multidimensional pain measurement tools, drug use patterns, and chronic pain experiences in older adults receiving home care.

subtopics.label: Intraoperative Opioid Exposure & Oncologic Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research investigating the relationship between intraoperative opioid administration and cancer-related outcomes, including tumor genomics, survival differences, and perioperative ischemic risk in cancer patients.
subtopics.short_description: Relationship between intraoperative opioid administration and tumor genomics, survival, and perioperative ischemic risk.

subtopics.label: Perioperative Transfusion Practices & Blood Management
subtopics.description: Studies on blood product utilization and transfusion practices in surgical settings including cardiac surgery, liver transplantation, and pediatric craniosynostosis repair, examining outcomes and standardization of transfusion protocols.
subtopics.short_description: Blood product utilization and transfusion protocols in cardiac surgery, liver transplantation, and pediatric craniosynostosis repair.

subtopics.label: Sickle Cell Disease, Musculoskeletal Pain & Comorbidity Burden
subtopics.description: Research on pain and health outcomes in sickle cell disease and musculoskeletal conditions, including surgical morbidity, stress measurement, aromatase inhibitor-related musculoskeletal symptoms, and arthritis prevalence in caregivers.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical morbidity, aromatase inhibitor-related symptoms, and comorbidity burden in sickle cell and musculoskeletal conditions.

subtopics.label: Sleep, Neurophysiology & Cognitive Function in Pain Contexts
subtopics.description: Studies examining the intersection of sleep health, neurophysiological monitoring, and cognitive or motor performance in pain-related and perioperative contexts, including dexmedetomidine sleep modulation, cortical arousal tracking, and physiatrist sleep documentation.
subtopics.short_description: Sleep health, cortical arousal monitoring, and cognitive performance in perioperative and chronic pain contexts.

subtopics.label: Prostate Biopsy Techniques & Urologic Procedural Pain
subtopics.description: Research comparing transperineal versus transrectal prostate biopsy approaches for infection prevention and cancer detection, and evaluating in-office ablative procedures for prostate cancer with attention to pain and procedural outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Transperineal versus transrectal biopsy for infection prevention and cancer detection, with evaluation of in-office ablative procedures.
